title: Unit-coefficient proper forget-supports normalizes the diagonal section
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X→S proper, and p=p_a either projection from X×_S X to X. For the canonical diagonal section and constant/tensor-unit comparisons, the compactly supported diagonal section map followed by the proper forget-supports comparisons equals the composite of the ordinary supported units, specialized to the tensor unit and its identity map.

source.place: The equation M = Rp2_* Delta_* M for the constant object and the diagonal section identity.

proof.text: For the identity morphism, the composition law of upperStarConstantSheafIso and upperStarComp_id_left show that its constant-object comparison is upperStarId. The exact single-object unit comparison therefore identifies supportedDerivedUnit at the identity with the inverse of the canonical ordinary derived identity comparison. Prove compatibility of this latter comparison with single objects from the derived-functor factorization equations.

For any proper section e followed by p with e;p=id, apply properShriekComp_comp_forgetSupports to the specified compositor. Cancel its inverse and the identity proper forget-supports comparison. The supported section followed by the two proper comparisons and ordinary composition is exactly the inverse ordinary identity comparison, on every coefficient complex.

Apply supportedDerivedUnit_comp to e and p, transporting its composite to id. The ordinary compositor written as a conjugate under the derived adjunctions is the canonical ordinary compositor, so the two supported units followed by it give supportedDerivedUnit at id.

Take e to be the diagonal and p to be the selected projection. The Boolean cases identify diagonalUnit with the specified section compositor using diagonal_fst or diagonal_snd. Postcompose both sides with the ordinary composition isomorphism, use its naturality for constantUnit.hom, apply the preceding two identities, and use naturality of the ordinary identity comparison to cancel constantUnit.inv with constantUnit.hom. Functoriality removes the explicit identity maps.

proof_origin.place: The constant-object diagonal section normalization, proved using existing proper compositor compatibility and ordinary constant-unit composition. Identity normalization and the conjugation by constantUnit are proved in private helpers.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalSection_forgetSupports_unit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] (a : Bool) :
    diagonalUnit A f a ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (projection f a)).map
          ((ordinaryProperForgetComparison A
              (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).hom.app
                (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
            (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).map
              (𝟙 (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X))) ≫
        (ordinaryProperForgetComparison A
          (projection f a)).hom.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).obj
              (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X)) =
      (constantUnit A X).inv ≫ supportedDerivedUnit A (projection f a) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          (supportedDerivedUnit A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).map
            ((constantUnit A X).hom ≫
              𝟙 (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X)))
